spec_text_or_path: Hades Doom: hit applies a tag on enemy; after fixed delay (1.1s) the tag detonates for burst damage. Multiple stacks detonate independently. Closest engine analog = TEMPORAL_CHARGE + burst-damage consequence, but the delay-before-detonation shape and tag-stacking are novel. Engine has no 'apply tag → wait N seconds → auto-fire burst at tag-holder' mechanism.

Hades Divine Dash / Merciful End: deflecting a projectile reflects it back at its source with counter-damage. Not in 16-ailment registry (§2 ref: 'Deflect is NOT an ailment (def-bin rider deflect_condition)'). Engine has no projectile-reflection geometry or defensive mechanic. Closest = RETRIBUTION_ENGINE T4 but that is a passive damage-taken-converts shape; deflect is active/directional. Separate from thorns/retaliation.

Hades Aspect of Guan Yu: equipping the aspect permanently reduces max HP and healing by 50–70% (scales with aspect level 1–5). This is a permanent-on-equip stat-penalty, not a per-cast HP cost. engine hp_cost_scale is per-cast (≤0.30 LOCKED). Guan Yu's penalty is equipment-level and exceeds the lock ceiling. Docket for potential new economy key: equip_stat_penalty_fraction.

Hades Merciful End: build identity requires both Ares-line boon (Doom on attack) AND Athena-line boon (Deflect on dash/attack) to unlock the duo boon, which IS the kit's capstone and identity. The build cannot be described as 'one skill + supports' — it is a cross-deity boon pairing where the interaction between two boon-lines generates the primary damage verb. No engine capstone analog: engine capstones are single mastery tree nodes, not cross-source synergy conditions.

Hades Beowulf Cast Build: Cast button loads bloodstones into shield (no natural depletion limit); Dragon Rush (powered Bull Rush) releases all loaded bloodstones simultaneously as a radial AoE shockwave at the rush destination. Economy shape: accumulate charges via Cast → release-all on triggered dash-attack. Bloodstones retrieved via pickup (not time-based refill). Differs from charge_stack (time-based) and from standard cast ammunition (fixed pool). Closest: TEMPORAL_CHARGE but pickup-dependent refill is the distinguishing mechanism.

Hades Aspect of Chiron: Special volley fires 4–8 arrows each independently applying boon effects (e.g. Demeter Chill per arrow = multiple stacks of chill per special use; Hangover stacks per arrow). Per-projectile status-application multiplicative with projectile count is a scaling shape. This is boon-variable (which boon is picked per run determines which status stacks), not a base-kit identity — but the per-projectile-status-stack amplification pattern warrants noting. Distinct from the standard multi_projectile geometry: the identity is the per-projectile independent boon-effect application.
